lrw.text: Eidren, a perfect of Lys Alana, orders hundreds of trees uprooted and rearranged into a beautiful pattern, creating the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
He becomes Gilt-Leaf taercenn after Nath's death, and Brion, who has killed most of the elves, dies when Eidren throws moonglove extract at his throat.
Eidren stops Gryffid from killing the captured Rhys and offers him a deal, which Rhys accepts moments before the Great Aurora strikes.
He also reveals that he has enchanted himself with nettlevines, shortening his life to under two years.
